episodes.synopsis: Shinozaki confesses to Kosaka, the girl of his dreams. In return, she offers to learn all the ways of being a good girlfriend for him... ALL the ways. Is she doing too much?
episodes.title: No, don't open it so wide please...

episodes.synopsis: It's little sister vs. girlfriend as Kosaka and Kanata "fight" for Shinozaki's attention. Later, Kosaka begs Ariyama for cooking lessons and gets more than she bargained for.
episodes.title: "Just whip it out now!" ...can I say that?

episodes.synopsis: When Shinozaki visits Kosaka's house, he discovers that Kosaka's attractive mother is just as odd as her daughter. Later, Kosaka furiously studies for their first date.
episodes.title: Ah, This is My First Time Having Two at Once...

episodes.synopsis: A new student arrives, and this sheltered girl partners with Kosaka to study men. When Shinozaki fails to "satisfy" her, the new girl, Rina, explores other options.
episodes.title: S-so this is how it goes, huh...

episodes.synopsis: The girls are giving Shinozaki a hard time until they misunderstand a certain question. What hilarious answers will the girls give Shinozaki?
episodes.title: It tore... What do I do?!

episodes.synopsis: Kosaka has made a new friend, Seiya. Unfortunately for Shinozaki this opens up a lot of new feelings and he can’t quite keep his jealousy in check.
episodes.title: D-don't show this to anyone else, okay?

episodes.synopsis: Shinozaki and Akiho find a lost dog and are instantly taken with it. Meanwhile, a school camping trip is announced and hilarity ensues.
episodes.title: Jeez... I can't get my mind off of it...

episodes.synopsis: Igarashi catches Shinozaki in a questionable situation, and to make matters worse she ends up in an embarrassing one! Later on Akiho has her own dilemma to deal with.
episodes.title: I-I'm not saying you can take it that far!

episodes.synopsis: Shinozaki is unable to go on a date with Akiho because of some family issues. Shizuku on the other hand, is more than happy to step in!
episodes.title: I told you, not so suddenly!!

episodes.synopsis: As everyone begins to prepare for exams, Shinozaki reflects on his relationship with Akiho. Will the two be able to convey their honest feelings to one another?
episodes.title: I can't... take it... any longer!
